name: Jev Reply Gate
description: Asks TypeSafe Jev whether the assistant should answer an incoming group message. Mentions always get an answer.

assistantName.label: Assistant name override
assistantName.help: Leave empty to use the agent's identity.name from the OpenClaw config. Set it to show Jev a different name. The override also counts as a mention.

assistantDescription.label: Assistant description
assistantDescription.help: One or two sentences on what the assistant is for. Jev uses it to judge relevance.

mentionPatterns.label: Mention patterns
mentionPatterns.help: Extra names or /regex/i patterns that count as a mention, on top of OpenClaw's own mention patterns. A mention always gets an answer.

threshold.label: Reply threshold
threshold.help: Reply when Jev's probability that an answer is wanted is at or above this value (0 to 1). Default 0.6.

bufferSize.label: Context buffer size
bufferSize.help: How many recent messages per conversation are sent to Jev as context. Default 8.

evaluateDirectMessages.label: Evaluate direct messages
evaluateDirectMessages.help: Off by default: direct messages are always answered. Turn on to gate them too.

failOpen.label: Reply when Jev is unreachable
failOpen.help: On by default: a Jev error lets the message through to the model. Off keeps the bot silent unless mentioned.

apiKey.label: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.help: Prefer the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable. This field is a fallback.
